nakshatras.name: Ashwini
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Impulsive, fiercely independent, quick to anger and quick to forgive. Struggles with patience; feels emotions as physical bursts of energy.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Kinesthetic / Experiential. Learns by touching, building, and trial-and-error rather than listening to passive lectures.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Give them 2 quick physical choices rather than open-ended demands. Burn physical energy before requesting focused tasks.

nakshatras.name: Bharani

soothing_mechanisms: Firm weighted pressure or deep hugs

nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Passionate, stubborn, deeply loving. Takes things deeply to heart; will hold their ground during power struggles until they feel acknowledged.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Tactile / Artistic. Absorbs complex ideas through creative expression, roleplay, and sensory crafts.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Avoid direct 'because I said so' confrontations. Acknowledge their desire first ('I see how badly you want this') before setting the boundary.

nakshatras.name: Krittika
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Protective, honest, blunt. Cannot tolerate perceived unfairness. Meltdowns resemble sudden bursts of lightning.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Analytical / Structural. Loves understanding rules, dissecting toys, and identifying patterns.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Never let their blood sugar dip low during transitions. Appeal to their innate sense of justice and fairness.

nakshatras.name: Rohini

sensory_profile.energy_type: Delicate, aesthetic, highly receptive to physical atmosphere

nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Tender, deeply affectionate, prone to clinginess when overwhelmed. Experiences sensory input with 2x intensity.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Visual / Auditory. Highly influenced by beautiful picture books, musical cadence, and gentle storytelling.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Cut tags off all clothes immediately. Create a tranquil, low-stimulus nursery or bedroom sanctuary.

nakshatras.name: Mrigashira

sensory_profile.energy_type: Alert, inquisitive, easily distracted by novelty

nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Gentle, inquisitive, perpetually restless. Constantly asking 'why?'; prone to anxiety if their curious questions are shut down.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Inquiry-based / Conversational. Learns best when following their own curiosity rather than rigid curriculum.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Answer their questions with curiosity: 'What do you think happens?' Keep their hands busy with puzzles and nature discovery.

nakshatras.name: Ardra

soothing_mechanisms: Crying without interruption in a parent's arms

nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Undergoes intense cathartic releases. Tantrums are not defiance; they are neurological system resets. Deeply brilliant and intuitive.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Problem-solving / Deconstruction. Fascinated by storms, how machines work, and complex emotional stories.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Do not try to teach or talk during their crying storm. Be their emotional anchor, stay physically close, and debrief only after the storm passes.

nakshatras.name: Punarvasu
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Forgiving, cheerful, naturally bounces back from setbacks. Needs a secure emotional home base to return to after exploring.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Holistic / Philosophical. Loves big-picture concepts, animals, and moral fables.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Praise their resilience and effort rather than perfection. Provide a cozy 'reset corner' in their room.

nakshatras.name: Pushya
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Naturally compliant, deeply compassionate, highly attuned to their mother's emotional state. May suppress their own needs to keep parents happy.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Structured / Observational. Thrives in predictable, calm classroom settings with warm teachers.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Check in on their feelings regularly: 'It is okay to be angry, you don't always have to be the good kid.' Protect your own emotional peace around them.

nakshatras.name: Ashlesha
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Hyper-observant, intense, fiercely protective of their boundaries. Can smell fear or insincerity instantly.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Independent / Investigative. Highly psychological, intuitive, and strategic.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Never force them to hug relatives if they say no. Respect their private space and earn their deep trust through radical honesty.

nakshatras.name: Magha
nakshatras.emotional_temperament: Proud, generous, natural leader on playgrounds. Deeply connected to ancestors and family lineage. Crushed by public reprimands.
nakshatras.learning_modality: Leadership / Mentorship. Learns best when teaching younger siblings or peers.
nakshatras.parenting_key: Never scold or correct them in front of friends or family. Pull them aside in private and speak to their inner dignity.
